title: Toscana.
note: A Val d'Orcia evening ray marched in a shader, cut into thick horizontal gradient strokes, with a Deco sunburst and a cypress breaking out of the frame.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] ray marches a Tuscan valley in a [[WebGL]] shader, every hill placed by hand: a white road lined with cypresses, a farmhouse on a knoll, ridges in the haze, a low sun with real shadows. Each 15 px row becomes one thick rounded gradient stroke, thicker in shadow, thinner in light, with a Deco sunburst cut into the sky and the near cypress breaking out of the frame. The title is [[Google Fonts]] Limelight, third choice after Poiret One and Italiana, set in the same strokes on the same grid; the rest is Josefin Sans on [[Canvas]].
